source: Game Designer v0.7 spec (room, 2026-10-17): light rival, never fights the player. Name ruling: Captain Rashid of the Red Dhow.

notes.fromMoon: spec: appears from moon 3 (1-based, Moon index 2)
notes.portChance: spec: ~1 arrival in 4, rolled per arrival
notes.cheapest: spec: buys the port's cheapest good for the visit: stock halved, price +20% (price restored at the next week tick)
notes.raceRouteWeeks: every leg is one week at sea in this build
notes.raceSpreadMoons: Jeff (final): his time = the player's shortest full trip from accept (delivery leg if carrying enough or on sale where you accept, else nearest source leg + delivery leg; 1 week per leg) + uniform(raceSpreadMinWeeks, raceSpreadMaxWeeks) weeks, continuous; he wins only if strictly earlier (tie to the player): ~2 in 3 for a player who sails the shortest trip
notes.OPEN_needs_Game_Designer_ruling: none open: race chance 0.34, clock on accept, tie to player, deposit back on loss, 2-week stay approved (Game Designer, 6f9eb00 ruling)
notes.taunts: taunt1 -> taunt2 -> taunt3 -> taunt1 cycle shared by meetings in port and taking a race; position saved (RivalState.tauntIdx)
notes.seaView: at sea he is re-placed every frame under the gameplay camera's viewport point (x seaViewX0->seaViewX1 across the show window, y seaViewY just under the horizon, at most seaMaxDist away), so he stays in the player's frame; qaSeaRedPixels = red pixels (every 2nd px each way) the qa needs in the frame

art.note: design/rival_art_spec.md (Chief Art Designer). Portrait rows art/rashid-portrait bac7f0a; sail + icon art/rival-sail 6e45f5a.
art.iconNote: race icon: boardIconSize canvas units (1080-wide reference) but never under boardIconMinPx real screen px, so 40 px on a 1080-wide phone and 40 px in a 540-wide window

strings.name: Captain Rashid
strings.ticker: The Red Dhow is in port.
strings.raceTag: Rashid is chasing this one too. First to deliver gets paid.
strings.raceLostTitle: The Red Dhow got there first
strings.raceLostBody: Rashid delivered the {good} to {port} before you. The buyer paid him. Your deposit is returned.
strings.seaSighted: A red lateen on the horizon: Rashid's Red Dhow.
strings.inPort: Your hold smells of my profits, friend.
strings.taunt1: The Red Dhow was here first. As always.
strings.taunt2: I left you the scraps. Generous, no?
strings.taunt3: Following me? Wise. Late, but wise.
strings.raceWin: The sea favours the swift. Try again, little dhow.
strings.raceLoss: Hm. Well sailed. Enjoy it while it lasts.
strings.rumour: They say the Red Dhow makes for {port}.

lineNotes.inPort: tavern, when he is in port
lineNotes.taunt1: town card when you dock where he is (first meeting this visit)
lineNotes.taunt2: town card when he bought up the cheapest good (shown with taunt1 on alternating visits)
lineNotes.taunt3: when you accept a race contract
lineNotes.raceWin: he delivered first (he wins the race)
lineNotes.raceLoss: you delivered first (he loses the race)
lineNotes.rumour: tavern, always, names his next port
lineNotes.raceWindow: race card: his arrival window = your shortest trip + raceSpreadMinWeeks..raceSpreadMaxWeeks, at least 1 week
